content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to use a random generator that starts at a specific time instead of beginning with zero? For example, I want random intervals between 5 and 10 seconds. Can this be done with the built-in random generator? Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, you can start the random timer using an on-delay timer set to 5 seconds.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks about configuring the built-in random generator to initiate random intervals starting above zero, aiming for the 5 to 10-second range. The recommended workaround involves using an on-delay timer, but it remains unclear whether the generator itself allows direct configuration of the starting value. The system’s interface does not seem to provide this option natively.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the random generator to allow configuration of minimum and maximum interval thresholds for more flexible timing control.
